description: `<program ratelimit="100/fortnight">` uses a unit outside {sec, min, hour}. Per §40 the value must match `N/unit`, so E-MW-002 fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §40 — `ratelimit=` declares a request budget the compiler wires into the middleware pipeline. Its value is a fixed `N/unit` grammar with unit ∈ {sec, min, hour}; an unrecognized unit cannot be lowered to a window, and the only alternatives to rejecting it are to guess a window or to drop the limit — the second silently removes a protection the author asked for.
